title: Session 9: HTML Layout, Forms, and Elements

questions.questionText: HTML5 semantic tags are classified as:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Text-level and structural.

questions.questionText: Structural semantic tags are:
options: Block-level elements used to structure pages
questions.correctAnswer: Block-level elements used to structure pages
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Block-level elements used to structure pages.

questions.questionText: Text-level semantic tags are currently:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Inline elements.

questions.questionText: The <section> element represents:
options: A group of related content different from other content groups
questions.correctAnswer: A group of related content different from other content groups
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) A group of related content different from other content groups.

questions.questionText: The <header> element can be used:
options: At the top of the document or the top of a section
questions.correctAnswer: At the top of the document or the top of a section
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) At the top of the document or the top of a section.

questions.questionText: Can an HTML5 document have multiple <header> elements?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Yes.

questions.questionText: The <footer> element contains:
options: Information about the document or section
questions.correctAnswer: Information about the document or section
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Information about the document or section.

questions.questionText: The <aside> element represents content that is:
options: Related to the main text, often as a sidebar
questions.correctAnswer: Related to the main text, often as a sidebar
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Related to the main text, often as a sidebar.

questions.questionText: The <nav> element is used for:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Major navigational links.

questions.questionText: Which could be a source for an <article> element?
options: Blog entry, forum post, news story
questions.correctAnswer: Blog entry, forum post, news story
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Blog entry, forum post, news story.

questions.questionText: The <mark> tag is used for:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Highlighting words in a page.

questions.questionText: The <meter> tag displays:
options: A scalar measurement within a known range
questions.correctAnswer: A scalar measurement within a known range
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) A scalar measurement within a known range.

questions.questionText: Which attribute of <meter> specifies the maximum value of the range?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) max.

questions.questionText: The <progress> tag is used to:
options: Display the progress of a task
questions.correctAnswer: Display the progress of a task
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Display the progress of a task.

questions.questionText: In <progress>, the value attribute specifies:
options: How much of the task has been completed
questions.correctAnswer: How much of the task has been completed
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) How much of the task has been completed.

questions.questionText: The <header> tag differs from <head> because <header>:
options: Is used in the body for introductory content
questions.correctAnswer: Is used in the body for introductory content
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Is used in the body for introductory content.

questions.questionText: Navigation bars can be:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Horizontal or vertical.

questions.questionText: A text-based navigation bar has the advantage of:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Reduced loading time.

questions.questionText: A graphical navigation bar:
options: Uses icons and is visually appealing
questions.correctAnswer: Uses icons and is visually appealing
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Uses icons and is visually appealing.

questions.questionText: A disadvantage of graphical navigation bars is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Longer page loading time.

questions.questionText: A rollover effect in a navigation bar:
options: Swaps images when the mouse moves over them
questions.correctAnswer: Swaps images when the mouse moves over them
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Swaps images when the mouse moves over them.

questions.questionText: Image maps are images with:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Clickable areas.

questions.questionText: Which tag defines an image map?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) <map>.

questions.questionText: Which tag defines the clickable areas in an image map?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) <area>.

questions.questionText: Which attribute of links it to a map?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) usemap.

questions.questionText: The <div> tag defines:
options: A division in a Web page used to group block elements
questions.correctAnswer: A division in a Web page used to group block elements
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) A division in a Web page used to group block elements.

questions.questionText: Which position value is the default for a <div>?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) static.

questions.questionText: The top, bottom, left, and right properties work only if:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) The position property is set.

questions.questionText: Which HTML element is the container for form input elements?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) <form>.

questions.questionText: The action attribute of the form element defines:
options: The action to be performed when the form is submitted
questions.correctAnswer: The action to be performed when the form is submitted
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) The action to be performed when the form is submitted.

questions.questionText: Form controls include:
options: Check boxes, radio buttons, and text boxes
questions.correctAnswer: Check boxes, radio buttons, and text boxes
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Check boxes, radio buttons, and text boxes.

questions.questionText: HTML5 forms provide client-side validation:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Natively by the browser.

questions.questionText: Which new input type accepts e-mail addresses?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) type="email".

questions.questionText: To allow multiple e-mail addresses in an e-mail field, separate them with:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Commas.

questions.questionText: The for attribute of <label> must match the ______ of the element.
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) id.

questions.questionText: The id attribute value should be:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Unique within the document.

questions.questionText: The name attribute is used to reference:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Form data after submission.

questions.questionText: The input type for Web addresses is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) url.

questions.questionText: The input type for telephone numbers is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) tel.

questions.questionText: The tel input type does not impose a pattern because:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Phone formats vary across countries.

questions.questionText: The input type that displays a slider control is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) range.

questions.questionText: The step attribute of range specifies:
options: The interval for incrementing the value
questions.correctAnswer: The interval for incrementing the value
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) The interval for incrementing the value.

questions.questionText: The default value of the step attribute is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) 1.

questions.questionText: The input type that selects only the year and month is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) month.

questions.questionText: The input type that displays time in hours and minutes is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) time.

questions.questionText: The input type that provides a color picker is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) color.

questions.questionText: The color input value is a:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Hexadecimal number.

questions.questionText: The placeholder attribute:
options: Displays a hint to help users enter correct data
questions.correctAnswer: Displays a hint to help users enter correct data
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Displays a hint to help users enter correct data.

questions.questionText: The pattern attribute uses:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) A regular expression for validation.

questions.questionText: The multiple attribute:
options: Allows multiple values to be entered
questions.correctAnswer: Allows multiple values to be entered
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Allows multiple values to be entered.

questions.questionText: The <datalist> element is used with the ______ attribute to make a drop-down control.
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) list.

questions.questionText: Which method sets a custom error message in the HTML5 Forms API?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) setCustomValidity().

questions.questionText: Which method checks the validity of a field?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) checkValidity().

questions.questionText: Which pseudo-class styles an input that is invalid?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) :invalid.

questions.questionText: Which pseudo-class styles an input that is valid?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) :valid.
